title: Triage a log file
summary: Parse structured log lines, count by level, find the noisiest service.

tests.name: mixed log with junk lines
expected: first error: 2026-11-16T10:00:02Z loan-svc timeout calling cbs

hints: `line.split(maxsplit=3)` gives at most 4 parts: timestamp, level, service and the rest of the message.
`collections.Counter` counts for you. Missing keys read as 0, so `counts['WARN']` is safe.
For the top service, pick the highest count and break ties alphabetically: `min(c.items(), key=lambda kv: (-kv[1], kv[0]))`.
